title: Copilot code review environment: toolchains are set up in copilot-code-review.yml, not in the reviewer code
answers: Where is the Python and Node setup for the Copilot code reviewer configured?
Why does the Copilot review job check out the repo without credentials?
Which setup step runs before Copilot reviews a pull request, and how do I change its Python version pinning?
Where does the instruction file say the review environment is defined?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml, job steps that prepare the environment the Copilot code reviewer runs in; it covers checkout, shared Python/uv setup and shared Node setup before the review, and keeps the job's triggers, name, permissions, cache policy and timeout.
Rule: Add review-time toolchains (Python, uv, Node) to this workflow's steps using the shared composite actions ./.github/actions/setup-python and ./.github/actions/setup-node, not ad hoc install commands in the reviewer. Checkout uses persist-credentials: false. setup-python is called with pin-micro-version: false.
Constraints: Applies only to the copilot-code-review workflow job; regular CI workflows are configured separately. The reviewer's verification guidance in .github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md points to this file, so keep the two in sync when the environment changes. Does not change comment wording, which lives in the instruction file.
applies: Scope: the Copilot code review setup job in .github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml and its pointer in .github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md; not runtime library code.
says: Update the automated pull request reviewer to support the newest runtime version.
The automated code review workflow fails because a required runtime environment is not installed.
The code review bot crashed during setup while preparing the verification environment.
Change the language and toolchain versions available to the pull request reviewer.
The automated reviewer cannot run verification commands due to missing language dependencies.
search: Toolchain environments for Copilot code reviews are configured in .github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml rather than in reviewer code. Review-time setup for Python, uv, and Node must use composite actions ./.github/actions/setup-python with pin-micro-version: false and ./.github/actions/setup-node, with checkout setting persist-credentials: false. Verification guidance in .github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md points to this workflow file and must be kept in sync. This applies strictly to the copilot-code-review workflow job, not to regular CI workflows, runtime library code, or comment wording.
